note: Triennial election of Lisnaskea Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. One contest, for the Colebrook seat, the only contest for the council. The other thirty divisions were filled unopposed; the Impartial Reporter of 21 May 1964, p. 7, names every nominee by division, including one newcomer, Mr. James Lynch, for the vacant Rosslea seat (added 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Aghakillymaude' to Aghakillymaud (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Lisnaskea Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Aghakillymaud; the rounds were filed as Aghakillymaude (1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964); Aughakillymaude (1949, 1952). This round was filed as 'Aghakillymaude', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (aghakillymaude) answers with a redirect to this one.
